text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down sharply over 24 hours, with Ethereum's steeper 6.7% decline suggesting selective pressure on altcoins despite broad-based selling. Fear & Greed sits at neutral (50) with a slight week-long decline, indicating neither panic nor euphoria—just cautious positioning as Bitcoin dominance edges higher at 59.2%. Total volume remains solid at $96B, pointing to active participation rather than apathetic withdrawal.
